activity_summary: You named the two naves and the plain chest, and you did not stay. You said the blank was yours to fill or not, and you turned back. You did not seal the letter from the porch.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: attendee in Looked at the tomb from the porch and turned back

facets.activity: Stood in the porch and turned back

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Two naves, and a plain chest between the light and me.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The blank at home is mine.
